page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-2x.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for high-density compute tasks. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed through KVM virtualization, it is powered by an Intel Xeon 8469C processor running at 2.6 GHz. The configuration supplies 32 dedicated virtual cores paired with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding 6.0 GB of RAM per core. Parallel compute acceleration is provided by two hardware GPUs offering a combined total of 192 GB of GPU VRAM.

In terms of networking and I/O, the ecs.gn8v-2x.8xlarge delivers a baseline network throughput of 20 Gbps to support multi-node communication and data ingestion. Local disk storage is not bundled with the instance, meaning all operating system installations and persistent data structures must be hosted on external network-attached storage. This separation provides flexibility in volume sizing, though overall disk throughput relies on external network storage connectivity.

The large 192 GB GPU memory allocation alongside 32 dedicated CPU cores provides solid resource efficiency for parallel workloads that require massive accelerator memory buffers. The instance is suited for deep learning training, large-scale artificial intelligence inference, scientific simulations, molecular dynamics, and high-performance numerical computing.
